findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Server-side request forgery (SSRF)
 * @description Making HTTP requests to URLs derived from user input may allow attackers to access internal resources
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/ssrf
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module SsrfConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource or
    source instanceof DataFlow::ParameterNode
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      (
        call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "Request"]).getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember(["request", "urlopen"]).getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "request"]).getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("http").getMember("client").getMember("HTTPConnection").getACall()
      ) and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module SsrfFlow = TaintTracking::Global<SsrfConfig>;
import SsrfFlow::PathGraph

from SsrfFlow::PathNode source, SsrfFlow::PathNode sink
where SsrfFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "SSRF vulnerability from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) through user-controlled URLs in HTTP requests

/**
 * @name Unsafe archive extraction (Zip Slip)
 * @description Extracting archives without validating paths can lead to path traversal attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-archive-extraction
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("zipfile").getMember("ZipFile").getReturn().getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("tarfile").getMember(["open", "TarFile"]).getReturn().getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember("unpack_archive").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe archive extraction that could allow path traversal attacks."
findings.hypothesis: Archive extraction without path validation could allow zip slip attacks

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Regular expression denial of service (ReDoS)
 * @description Inefficient regular expressions can cause denial of service
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/redos
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, Expr pattern
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "findall", "finditer", "sub", "subn"]).getACall() and
    pattern = call.getArg(0).asExpr()
  ) and
  exists(StrConst s | s = pattern |
    // Look for potentially dangerous patterns
    s.getText().regexpMatch(".*[+*]{2,}.*") or
    s.getText().regexpMatch(".*(\\.|\\w)\\+.*\\+.*") or
    s.getText().regexpMatch(".*\\(.*\\)\\+.*\\(.*\\)\\+.*")
  )
select call, "Potentially inefficient regular expression that could cause ReDoS."
findings.hypothesis: Regular expressions with nested quantifiers or overlapping patterns can cause exponential time complexity leading to denial of service
